issues.problem: Labelled 'm. nom. du., dvandva', but the printed form ends in short -i; the dual of vardhaki would be vardhakī. The note even admits the short -i is 'kept as printed', which contradicts the dual label. Short -i is a compound-stem form: nāyaka-vardhaki-mauhūrtikāḥ is one dvandva (nom. pl.), the e-text's space before mauhūrtikāḥ being a missing compound mark. Sense is unchanged (all three are subjects of māpayeyuḥ).
